info.title: SnapList Mobile API
info.description: Provider-neutral HTTP contract for the native SwiftUI client. Contract-only operations are owned by the linked follow-up issue until implemented.

200.description: Runtime is accepting requests
Verified Clerk subject used by Supabase RLS
Tenant-scoped monotonic completion state for first-listing guidance
Idempotently records this seller's completion marker
Tenant-scoped Seller Home projection from durable server truth

503.description: The read-only Home projection is temporarily unavailable

200.description: Latest coherent immutable tenant-scoped pricing evidence snapshot

201.description: One-use handoff bound to the verified App Attest key, recovery, and immutable photo set

parameters.name: X-SnapList-Guest-Handoff
parameters.description: Opaque handoff verified by issue #174. It contains no client-defined deadline or account owner.

200.description: Stable claimed or expired outcome. Either terminal outcome requires local encrypted recovery deletion.
Exact idempotent replay of the previously committed submission

202.description: Item, allowance reservation, run, and queue message durably committed

403.description: Existing AI-item credit policy denied this submission; error.details.reason is stable

409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with different photo bytes, order, cost basis, accepted voice, or canonical voice locale

429.description: Existing daily or per-minute submission capacity was reached; error.details.reason is stable

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token for the frozen tenant snapshot.

200.description: Tenant-scoped snapshot-stable run history page with logical convergence identity and frozen ordering truth
Canonical tenant-owned durable run
The staged Listing Review save completed, or the same key and normalized intent replayed its original receipt

The guided identity correction reran the shared pricing router and confidence composite and durably committed the coherent result, or the same key and intent replayed its original receipt without paying the pricing provider again

202.description: Legal retry committed for the same logical run; response is a canonical refresh

200.description: Legal cancellation committed; response confirms canonical preserved run truth
Server-bound RevenueCat configuration for the verified Clerk principal; no request user id is accepted
Server-authoritative allowance period and remaining items

201.description: Server-created tenant-bound one-time OAuth state and Sandbox authorization URL; provider credentials never transit SwiftUI

200.description: Tenant-owned connected eBay account state without token material
Connection removed and connection generation advanced; existing eBay listings stay live but reconnect does not restore SnapList control
Server-mapped listing, connection, and publish-eligibility truth; this read performs no marketplace mutation
Provider-authoritative persisted outcome, including outcome_not_yet_known when a write may have committed
Exact-once canonical provider listing identity, including durable replay

303.description: Redirects to an app universal link carrying exactly one opaque result: connected, declined, cancelled, expired, wrong_tenant, invalid_state, in_progress, or failed. in_progress is a truthful nonterminal result and does not imply connection success or failure.

parameters.name: X-RevenueCat-Webhook-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC timestamp and digest over the raw JSON body

schema.description: RevenueCat lifecycle event; verified before tenant mapping or parsing

200.description: Verified and applied, reconciled, duplicated, or intentionally ignored
One bounded consume pass

ClerkBearer.description: Server verifies Clerk issuer, signature, expiry, and subject, and enforces configured authorized-party validation when an azp claim is present. The same token is forwarded only to an RLS-scoped Supabase client.

GuestBearer.description: Opaque, short-lived guest capability minted only after App Attest verification.

InternalBearer.description: Scheduler/worker secret or stronger platform identity; never available to SwiftUI.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable per logical mutation; replay returns the original result and never creates another run, credit, or provider action.

Forbidden.description: The device has no verified App Attest key. The guest allowance is refused; no recovery or tenant state changes.

RateLimited.description: Attestation capacity was reached before private verification authority was created

Conflict.description: The durable run changed or the requested transition is not legal

Unavailable.description: The server could not complete the operation safely; retry is permitted

NotFound.description: Resource absent or hidden by tenant isolation

UnprocessableEntity.description: A seller-fixable refusal the request itself cannot clear; the message names the condition and retrying unchanged will refuse again

assertionObject.description: Apple App Attest assertion object: CBOR containing authenticatorData and signature.

clientData.description: Exact UTF-8 JSON bytes signed through clientDataHash. Strict fields: version=1, purpose=guest-claim-handoff, recoveryId, opaque recoveryToken, and content_sha256_set_v1 photoIdentity.

items.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP image bytes

voiceContext.description: Optional WAV: RIFF/WAVE PCM S16LE, mono, 16 kHz, at most 15 seconds and 512 KiB. Bounded-invalid input becomes absent.

voiceContextLocale.description: Optional BCP-47 locale hint. Valid accepted voice hints are canonicalized; invalid hints become null.
